overview: EESL Energy Efficiency Innovation Support is a program by Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL) to facilitate business development through partnerships with technology service providers, channel partners, and strategic partners. It enables EESL to aggregate demand for consultancy services and energy efficiency projects across sectors like lighting, buildings, industry, electric mobility, smart metering, and agriculture. The program operates via registration processes where partners submit proposals, documents, and a refundable security deposit, and are evaluated for approval to collaborate on projects such as DEEP, Urja Bachat Sewa, and PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana in Odisha.
objectives: Facilitate business development through partnerships with technology service providers, channel partners, and strategic partners
Aggregate demand for consultancy services and energy efficiency projects across sectors
Create a project pipeline for consultancy services covering Energy Audit, GHG Accounting, Safety & Performance Audit, Water Audit, RE as a Service, Cooling as a Service, Lighting as a Service
Promote market transformation in energy efficiency under MSME sector
Support implementation of innovative energy-efficient technologies in PAT industries
Extend consultancy in areas like solar power, building energy efficiency, e-mobility, and agriculture demand side management
Enable EESL to remunerate registered partners with success fees or designated charges upon project completion
Ensure transparency, scalability, and flexibility in business models to incentivize all stakeholders
eligibility: Interested parties must register via the EESL website, submit a filled registration form along with requisite documents including GST Certificate, PAN Card, Demand Draft/NEFT/RTGS of Rupees One Lakh Only as refundable security deposit, To Whom It May Concern letter, Self-Declaration for Blacklisting, Contract Agreement copies, Non-Disclosure Agreement, PPP MII and Land Border Sharing Certificate, Compliance Matrix, EFT form, and Cancelled Cheque. Applicants must not have been blacklisted by any Central/State Government or Public Sector Undertaking.
benefits: Registered partners gain access to EESL's project pipeline, opportunity to generate leads and secure orders for energy efficiency projects, remuneration via success fees (4-5% of order value) or designated charges (5% of CFA & SFA per consumer), platform for promoting technology solutions, and collaboration with EESL on consultancy assignments. Benefits also include non-financial support such as technical guidance, project facilitation, and access to EESL's network of stakeholders including MSMEs, government bodies, and utilities.
financial_support: Financial support varies by partner type: Technology Solution Providers pay a one-time registration fee of INR 5,000 (including GST) and earn 5% of invoice value (excluding GST) as project facilitation fees, plus INR 25,000 per event for financial sponsorship. Channel Partners receive payments after deducting 5% of Central and State Financial Assistance per consumer as EESL charges for supervision and support. Strategic Partners earn success fees based on order value: 4% for orders between INR 0.10–10 Crores, 4.5% for INR 10–25 Crores, and 5% for orders above INR 25 Crores, payable upon receipt of payment from the end consumer. All partners must submit a refundable security deposit of INR 1 Lakh, returnable after 2 years and 3 months from contract execution.
application_process: 1. Visit EESL website and fill the registration form via the provided link (e.g., Registration of Technology Service Provider, Channel Partners, or Strategic Partners). 2. Submit the printed form along with all requisite documents in physical form as per EESL prescribed format. 3. Include a refundable security deposit of INR 1 Lakh via Demand Draft/NEFT/RTGS in favor of Energy Efficiency Services Limited. 4. Submit self-declaration for blacklisting on company letterhead. 5. Provide To Whom It May Concern letter, PPP MII and Land Border Sharing Certificate, Compliance Matrix, EFT form, and cancelled cheque. 6. Submit two copies of Contract/Definitive Agreement and Non-Disclosure Agreement on stamp paper after registration. 7. Send all documents via registered post to the specified address (e.g., GM (CDP) or Head (Cluster Contract) at EESL, Ikon Tower, Noida). 8. Await evaluation by EESL and approval by competent authority. 9. Receive Letter of Registration upon approval. 10. Execute Non-Disclosure Agreement within 7 days of registration letter issuance.
